title: Milestone dispatch persists receipts and safely retries only unaccepted messages
blast: Incomplete sends remain approved with durable per-draft attempt history. Atomic claims prevent overlapping dispatch; accepted drafts are skipped; uncertain attempts reuse the same provider key within 23 hours. A complete ledger can finalize beyond TTL without another send. Provider acceptance is not inbox delivery, and legacy or unverifiable history requires staff reconciliation.

title: Partner notification helpers surface resolved provider errors with diagnostics
blast: Both partner send helpers inspect the SDK result, await an error diagnostic and rethrow failures to callers. Existing preference/configuration no-op conditions remain; this fix adds neither a generic partner outbox nor delivery confirmation.
